Read this to start 2025 off on the right foot.

The big Shopify screenshots that you see are always in USD. Go sell worldwide. It has never been easier to reach & deliver to the entire world.

Systems & people will get you from good to great results.

Focus on maximizing your conversion rate. It will be a long-term value add that will make every other thing that you implement and do with your brand work smoother.

Don’t try to reinvent the wheel yourself every time, learn from others, get inspired by others, take what's winning, and make it your own.

Little details can make a huge impact, never think you know it all, student of the game mentality, always.

Invest in your relationships with your people, with partners, with suppliers, with mentorships, remember we play long-term vision. Never put your morals to the side for a “short term” money grab. 

At the end, it's not about just the money anyways. Relationships are everything. Not only in business.

All our brands crushed it this Q4 and thats purely by applying the above principles and obviously by hard and smart work. 

Go get them 🤝

tweets.text:
If you can’t get in front of your ideal customer at least 3 times, your marketing will fail.

And if you are selling an expensive product worth over $10,000, people will need to interact roughly 23 times before they make a purchase.

This is why you shouldn’t assume a marketing channel isn’t driving sales.

Just because your analytics may show that people aren’t buying through a specific channel, it doesn’t always mean the chase.

For example, people could find you on the social web but buy because of a Google ad.

Check out how many times someone “roughly” needs to see and interact with your brand before buying.
